data.name: Anoop
data.gender_notes: Anoop is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Anoop originated from the Sanskrit language, which means 'pure', 'serene', and 'free from anxiety'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Krishna, who embodies these qualities. Anoop is a name that inspires peace, calmness, and inner happiness. The name Anoop carries the meaning “Pure, Serene, Free from Anxiety” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anoop usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, serene, free from anxiety and live with faith, good character and purpose.
